DIAGNOSIS: Cerebellar ataxia, likely idiopathic late-onset cerebellar ataxia

1. Normal pressure hydrocephalus
2. Multiple system atrophy (cerebellar type)

2. Palpate dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses bilaterally
3. 10-gram monofilament test for protective sensation
4. Ankle-brachial index (ABI) measurement
5. Weight-bearing X-ray of both feet
6. ECG
7. HbA1c
8. Lying and standing blood pressure measurement
